SEARCH
Package neqsim.process.equipment.separator

Class SeparatorTransientEnergyBalanceTracker

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.separator.SeparatorTransientEnergyBalanceTracker
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
final class SeparatorTransientEnergyBalanceTracker extends Object implements Serializable, Cloneable
Constant-storage accounting owned by one opt-in separator diagnostic.

Pending fields are transactional. Accepted scalar fields and the immutable last report are copied by native separator checkpoints. No history or external thermodynamic reference is retained.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

      void recordEquation(double before, double target, double netRate, double inletRate, double gasRate, double liquidRate, double heatRate, double inletMolarRate, double gasMolarRate, double liquidMolarRate, boolean liquidApplied)
      Retains the exact ordered integration terms before component or outlet updates.

      before - actual pre-update inventory energy, J

      heatRate - applied heat, W

      liquidMolarRate - supplied liquid outlet molar rate, mol/s
